dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three primary irregular ring-like structures visible on the left flank; edges characterized by high-contrast light pixels transitioning sharply into dark interiors. The largest central structure has a jagged, non-uniform perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily along the dorsal margin and interspersed between the larger annuli structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct rings form an irregular triangular pattern across the dorsal-lateral plane.
